Creating an enrollment hold (trancamento) now removes the student's class enrollments that fall within the hold period and are still "Incompleto". I haven't run the specs or tried it in the app. I only checked that the file parses.

The change is in `app/models/enrollment_hold.rb`: a new `cancel_class_enrollments` callback runs after a hold is created. A class counts as inside the hold when its semester starts on or between the hold's start and end dates. Class enrollments already marked Aprovado or Reprovado are left alone.

The issue says "cancelar", but there is no "canceled" situation in the system. I chose to delete the records, and PaperTrail should keep a history of them. If you'd rather keep them, the alternative is to add a new "Cancelada" situation to `ClassEnrollment` and set that instead. That would touch the validations, locale strings and PDF helper, so say so if you want it.

The callback only runs when a hold is created. Editing an existing hold, for example extending it by a semester, does not cancel any further class enrollments.
